name: Camp Greylock
description_short: A traditional overnight camp for boys ages 6 to 16 on Center Lake in Becket, Massachusetts. The program covers land sports, watersports, arts and adventure, and campers are split evenly between junior and senior groups.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lakefront campus on Center Lake. Activities include swimming, sailing, boating, canoeing, waterskiing, wakeboarding and tubing.

source.title: The Best Boys Sports Camp Near You, Greylock Sleepaway Camp
